# Bundled math renderer

MathJax 3.2.2 (Apache-2.0) is bundled for local equation rendering.
The distribution's license is retained at `mathjax/LICENSE`.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjax/-/mathjax-3.2.2.tgz
Project: https://www.mathjax.org/
Retrieved: 2026-09-08.

Included files are the `es5/tex-mml-chtml.js` bundle, TeX extensions under
`es5/input/tex/extensions` and CommonHTML fonts under
`es5/output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2`. The rest of the package is unnecessary
for this book and is not included. No source maps or package manager
directories are kept.
